response.content: {"critique": "The problem is that third-party bank details cannot be verified before claims payment processing, causing delays and reissues. I checked the five most similar items: story 4129 (completed) covers automatic supplier contact details, not bank account verification; story 4134 (in progress) covers task list interface improvements; and the three Notion pages are generic release notes about workflow, error logging, and document upload improvements.
